title: Can the Thoracic Replace the Conventional Radiography for the Diagnosis of Acute Pneumonia in Children?
brief_summary: The Thoracic ultrasound is a safer and sensitive technique than conventional radiography because it detects less than 1 cm pneumonic consolidations and minimal pleural effusions. The main objective is to evaluate the efficacy of thoracic ultrasound performed by unskilled personnel in the emergency service prdiatricas to diagnose pneumonia in children.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* fever above 38 degrees
* tachypnea
* Difficulty breathing
* Side tip pain
* pathological auscultation

Exclusion Criteria:

* \< 3 months\> 14 years
* Background of Prematurity
* Rewalizados imaging studies in the last 7 days
* Any chronic respiratory process
* congenital heart diseases
* hemodynamic instability
* Diagnosis of pneumonia in the last 3 months
* Refusal of relatives to participate in the study
